needs.source: TI SLOS080W, 8.3 Power Supply Recommendations: 0.1-µF bypass capacitors close to the power-supply pins; 8.4: a single bypass capacitor from VCC+ to ground for single-supply applications

hints: on a single 9 V supply the TL072C's guaranteed common-mode range (5.8: ±11 V at ±15 V – 4 V from each rail) is 4 V wide less than the supply: a bias at half of 8.7 V leaves 0.35 V to either end – the input signal's peaks go beyond it
inputs are diode-clamped to both rails: limit the current of a signal more than 0.5 V beyond them to 10 mA (5.1 note 2)

compliance.source: TI SLOS080W: an operational amplifier, no transmitter – read 2026-10-31; RoHS and REACH not read

sources: TI TL07xx Low-Noise, FET-Input Operational Amplifiers, SLOS080W (September 1978, revised July 2025), from TI https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tl072.pdf, read 2026-10-31; LCSC C7236 is TI TL072CP, PDIP-8 (JLCPCB catalogue 2026-10-31 (edakit part search): Extended Part, 5 535 pcs)

pins: 4 Pin Configuration and Functions, Figure 4-5 and Table 4-3 (TL072x D, DDF, JG, P, PS, PW): 1 1OUT, 2 1IN−, 3 1IN+, 4 VCC−, 5 2IN+, 6 2IN−, 7 2OUT, 8 VCC+; VCC− typed ground with the role vee (the op-amp model's negative rail): the pedals tie it to ground

vdd_max_v 42: 5.1 supply voltage (V+) − (V−) 0 … 42 V for all devices but the NS and PS packages and the TL07xM (36 V); vdd_op_min_v 4.5, vdd_op_max_v 40: 5.3 recommended supply voltage, all other devices (the NS, PS and M devices: 10 … 30 V)

vin_rel_max_v 0.5, v_min_v −0.5 and i_inject_max_a 0.01 on the inputs: 5.1 common-mode voltage (VCC−) − 0.5 … (VCC+) + 0.5 V and current −10 … 10 mA for all other devices; note 2: input pins diode-clamped to both rails

vicm_v [4, −4]: 5.8 (TL07xC) common-mode voltage VCM ±11 V minimum at VS = ±15 V (typical −12 … 15 V) – 4 V from each rail, the guaranteed range; 5.3 recommends inputs from (VCC−) + 4 V to (VCC+) + 0.1 V for all other devices – the lower end the same, the upper end taken from 5.8, the stricter
vout_swing_v [3, −3]: 5.8 maximum peak output voltage swing ±12 V minimum at VS = ±15 V, RL = 10 kΩ – 3 V from each rail
iq_a 0.005: 5.8 quiescent current per amplifier 2.5 mA maximum (1.4 typical) at VO = 0, no load – both channels
gain_min_ratio 1: 5.9 phase margin 56° at G = +1 (TL07xC, RL = 10 kΩ, CL = 20 pF) – unity-gain stable
t_min_c 0, t_max_c 70: 5.3 specified temperature of the TL07xC; tj_max_c 150: 5.1; rth_ja_k_per_w 85: 5.5 RθJA of the TL072x P (PDIP) package
decoupling: 8.3 – 0.1-µF bypass capacitors close to the power-supply pins
notes: Dual JFET-input op-amp in PDIP-8, the TS stage and tone control of the GuitarML Tubescreamer/Rat combo. Library draft.

checked: 5.8: VCM ±11 V min, VOM ±12 V min (10 kΩ), IQ 2.5 mA max per amplifier
open: common-mode range and output swing are given at ±15 V only; the model takes the same distance from the rails at 9 V
the LCSC copy of C7236 is the older revision SLOS080L; this entry follows SLOS080W from ti.com
